reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: A senior secured loan of up to EUR 22 million to Bioforce Viiratsi OU ("Bioforce Viiratsi" or the "Company"), a special purpose company incorporated in Estonia for the purpose of developing and operating a biomethane production plant (the "Project"). The Project will benefit from the EBRD InvestEU Framework for Biofuels Development. The Bank's proceeds will be used for the construction of a biomethane plant in Viiratsi in Estonia with an annual production capacity of 112 GWh. The Project is expected to contribute towards achieving the country's renewable fuel target and become the fourth waste-to-biomethane production plant of Bioforce Group OÜ (the "Group") and largest in the Baltic region, thus turning the Group into a leading producer in Estonia and an active promoter of green solutions to Estonia's public transport.
